ex.zh: 一点一点地，登山者们把自己拉了上去，越过了第二台阶。

ex.en: Kids can also be taught to do their bit for helping the environment.
ex.zh: 也可以教孩子们为保护环境尽自己的一份力。

ex.en: I'm a bit tired today.
ex.zh: 我今天有点累。

ex.en: A little bit of progress will get you moving.
ex.zh: 一点点进步就能推动你前进。

ex.en: "It's more important to learn from your mistakes so that you don't repeat them in future.
ex.zh: “更重要的是从错误中学习，以后不再重犯。

ex.en: Once, when he tried to order his meal, he kept repeating sounds.
ex.zh: 有一次，他想点餐时，一直重复同样的音。

ex.en: If we pull together, we should win next time," Matt smiled.
ex.zh: “如果我们齐心协力，下次就该赢了。”马特笑着说。

ex.en: If we all pull together, we can finish the work today.
ex.zh: 如果大家齐心协力，今天就能完成这项工作。

ex.en: Complete the problems and solutions.
ex.zh: 完成这些问题和解决办法。

ex.en: A new kind of plastic may be a good solution to this problem.
ex.zh: 一种新型塑料也许是解决这个问题的好办法。

ex.en: People were standing on my right and left, even though there was plenty of space on the bus!
ex.zh: 人们站在我的左右两边，尽管公交车上有足够的空间！

ex.en: Though she walked slowly, she did everything with care and purpose.
ex.zh: 虽然她走得很慢，但她做每件事都很用心、有目的。

ex.en: I'm inspired by how hard the fisherman fights, even though he loses the fish in the end.
ex.zh: 那个渔夫拼命搏斗的样子激励了我，尽管他最后还是失去了那条鱼。

ex.en: Even though it was not worth much, the joy it brought me was huge.
ex.zh: 虽然它不值多少钱，但它带给我的快乐是巨大的。

ex.en: I apologize for being late.
ex.zh: 我为迟到道歉。

ex.en: It is important to apologize.
ex.zh: 道歉是很重要的。

senses.zh: 出现问题；发生故障；搞错

ex.en: When something goes wrong, it's easy to get angry.
ex.zh: 事情出了差错时，人们很容易生气。

ex.en: When things go wrong, don't be too hard on laoji.
ex.zh: 事情出了差错时，不要对老纪太苛刻。

ex.en: The Spring Festival is a joyful time for families.
ex.zh: 春节是家人团聚的快乐时光。

ex.en: She sang a joyful song.
ex.zh: 她唱了一首欢快的歌。

ex.en: We were so thankful that they found us!
ex.zh: 他们找到了我们，我们真是太感激了！

ex.en: By the end of the project, Alia felt thankful for the experience.
ex.zh: 项目结束时，阿莉娅很感激这段经历。

ex.en: Can you talk about positive and negative emotions?
ex.zh: 你能谈谈积极和消极的情绪吗？

ex.en: Focus on learning from the situation rather than paying attention to negative emotions.
ex.zh: 关注从中学到什么，而不是关注消极情绪。

ex.en: We should say no to bullying.
ex.zh: 我们应该对霸凌说不。

ex.en: If they don't stop, try to tell an adult about the bullying.
ex.zh: 如果他们不停止，试着把霸凌的事告诉大人。

ex.en: We should say no to bullying. (shock) I'm sorry I shouted at you just now.
ex.zh: 我们生气时，可能会冲别人大喊大叫，或对他们说刻薄的话。

ex.en: Smith wasn't angry and didn't shout at me.
ex.zh: 史密斯没有生气，也没有冲我嚷嚷。

ex.en: To their surprise, the tornado behaved in an unexpected way.
ex.zh: 让他们吃惊的是，龙卷风的行为出人意料。

ex.en: The dogs must be calm, follow orders, and behave well.
ex.zh: 这些狗必须冷静、服从命令、举止得体。

ex.en: How are for and since used differently?
ex.zh: for和since的用法有什么不同？

ex.en: This is why two people can remember the same event differently, even if they were both there.
ex.zh: 这就是为什么两个人即使都在场，对同一件事的记忆也会不同。
